SELECT AS group_value, COUNT(DISTINCT filtered.work_item_id) AS group_count FROM ( SELECT proj_work_item.id AS work_item_id, proj_work_item.tenant_id AS tenant_id
, proj_work_item.${groupField.column} AS group_value
FROM proj_work_item WHERE proj_work_item.deleted = 0
AND ${ew.sqlSegment}
) filtered
LEFT JOIN proj_work_item_field_value field_value ON field_value.work_item_id = filtered.work_item_id AND field_value.tenant_id = filtered.tenant_id AND field_value.field_id = #{groupField.customFieldId} AND field_value.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN proj_work_item_field_value_option field_option ON field_option.work_item_id = filtered.work_item_id AND field_option.tenant_id = filtered.tenant_id AND field_option.field_id = #{groupField.customFieldId} AND field_option.deleted = 0
GROUP BY ORDER BY CASE WHEN IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, group_count DESC, ASC

SELECT sprint_id, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = #{completedStatus} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count FROM proj_work_item WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND sprint_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY sprint_id
